reasoning: A shield containing a heart is the standard visual metaphor for health insurance, life insurance, and medical coverage. It fits a common, well-defined cluster of personal admin and finance tasks (open enrollment, claims, policies, beneficiaries) while remaining distinct from a plain security shield or a standalone medical heart.
